cells.message:
fix(terminal): guard truncated OSC sequences

HandleOSC crashed on sequences shorter than the escape
prefix. Length check now rejects truncated input before
prefix matching.

fix(osc): reject short OSC input

Prefix-only guard let sequences under three bytes through,
panicking HandleOSC. Added len(seq) < 3 rejection.

fix(terminal/osc): stop crash on truncated sequences

Guard now requires both the escape prefix and a minimum
length, so malformed input errors out instead of crashing.

fix(terminal): guard truncated OSC sequences

Truncated input crashed HandleOSC; minimum length check
now errors before prefix match.

fix(osc): reject truncated OSC input

len < 3 slipped past prefix check, crashing handler. Length
guard added.

fix(terminal): fix crash on short OSC input

Prefix-only guard missed one- and two-byte sequences,
panicking HandleOSC. Length check added.

terminal: guard truncated OSC sequences

HandleOSC previously trusted the OSC escape prefix alone
and crashed when the sequence was shorter than three bytes.
The guard now also checks sequence length, so truncated
input is rejected with an error instead of crashing.

terminal: reject malformed OSC input

The old check only verified the sequence started with the
OSC escape; anything shorter than three bytes slipped
through and crashed the handler. A minimum length check now
rejects those sequences before prefix matching, returning
the usual error.

terminal/osc: stop crash on truncated sequences

Previously HandleOSC matched only the escape prefix, so
one- and two-byte sequences reached operations they were
too short for and crashed. The guard now combines the
prefix check with a length check, returning an error for
truncated input.

fix(terminal): handle truncated OSC sequences without crashing

HandleOSC only checked the escape prefix, so sequences
shorter than 3 bytes crashed the terminal. Added a length
guard that rejects truncated input with the existing
"not an OSC sequence" error.

fix: prevent crash on truncated OSC sequences

The prefix check in HandleOSC passed for one- and two-byte
input, which then crashed downstream. Now the guard also
requires len(seq) >= 3 before treating input as an OSC
sequence, returning an error for anything shorter.

fix(osc): validate sequence length before processing

Truncated OSC sequences slipped past the HasPrefix check
and crashed HandleOSC. The combined condition rejects them
up front with the standard error.
